about.aboutapp: NativeWeather is an application for displaying current weather and forecasts. It also displays current air pollution values and maps for the whole world.
about.googlemaps: Basic map background for interactive display of geographic data
about.openmeteo: Specialized data for air quality index (AQI) and pollution
about.openweather: Provides visualization of meteorological map layers for temperature, precipitation, and cloud cover
about.title: About
about.weatherapi: The main source of data for current weather and forecasts and astronomical data
